Mid/Senior Full Stack Developer (Python / Frontend) 
 A global financial services and insurance organization is looking for a Mid/Senior Full Stack Developer to develop high-performing, scalable backend systems and architectural solutions within their technology hub.
 Role Overview: 
 Work Model: Hybrid (3 days office / 2 days remote)
 Location: Bucharest, Romania
 Employment Type: Full-time
 Key Responsibilities: 
Design, implement, test, and deploy scalable, business-critical features using Python.
Build responsive, user-friendly frontend interfaces using modern web technologies.
Collaborate across cross-functional Agile teams to tackle complex technical challenges and business workflows.
Apply DevSecOps standards, performance profiling, and continuous automated testing to maintain high software quality.
Write clear technical documentation and maintain architecture specifications.
 Requirements: 
 Core Technical Experience: Mid-to-senior experience building complex backend applications in Python using modern frameworks (Flask, Django, or FastAPI), API design, and databases (SQL/PostgreSQL, NoSQL/MongoDB).
 Frontend Experience: Experience in frontend web development; Angular proficiency is highly desired.
 Cloud & DevOps: Practical background with Azure Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, and DevSecOps practices.
 Education & Languages: Degree in Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent experience; professional fluency in English (written and spoken).
 Nice to Have: 
Knowledge of MLOps platforms and AI/Data Processing algorithms (ML, DL, NLP).
Knowledge of French.
 What’s Offered: 
Flexible hybrid working model (3 days office / 2 days remote).
Global exposure to high-impact financial and risk management software projects.
Opportunity to work with cutting-edge cloud, DevSecOps, and AI-adjacent technology stacks.
 Interested in joining the team? 
 Apply directly to this post or send your CV to mara@brainsource.io .
